settings.heading: NAIL SIZING GUIDE
settings.tagline: FILE YOUR FIT // FIND YOUR SIZE
settings.introduction: Every scene deserves the right fit. Follow these steps to find the press-on nail size that works best for you.
settings.sizing_notice: Our size chart is a guide. Nail beds vary, so we recommend checking your measurements carefully and ordering a sizing kit if one is available.

settings.title: 01 // PREP
settings.description: Remove any nail polish and make sure your natural nails are clean and dry.

settings.title: 02 // MEASURE
settings.description: Use flexible measuring tape or a narrow strip of transparent tape. Measure across the widest part of each natural nail, from sidewall to sidewall.

settings.title: 03 // MARK & MEASURE
settings.description: Place transparent tape across your nail and mark both edges. Remove and flatten the tape, then measure between the marks in millimetres (mm).

settings.title: 04 // MATCH YOUR FILE
settings.description: Compare each measurement with our NailScene size chart. Measure all ten nails individually, as your left and right hands may differ.

settings.title: 05 // CHECK YOUR FIT
settings.description: If your measurement falls between two sizes, choose the larger size and gently file the sides of the press-on if needed.
